lines.text: All the forefathers were under the cloud, passed through the sea, and were baptized into Moses.
They drank from the spiritual rock, which was Christ, yet God was not pleased with most of them.
Twenty-three thousand died in one day for sexual immorality, and some who tested Christ were killed by scorpions.
God will provide an escape when you are tempted, so Paul tells his beloved to flee from pride.
Sacrifices are offered to demons, and we cannot partake in the table of the Lord and the table of demons.
